svg.title: Criticality stays below the paging threshold
svg.desc: Use a measured-looking severity bar that ends below a clearly labelled paging threshold, without inventing a numeric score. Spatial shortfall must explain the missing escalation.

Spatial shortfall must explain the missing escalation.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "location-background-huggingface-security-stack", "box": [ 0.02, 0.02, 0.96, 0.96 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "threshold", "box": [ 0.227, 0.0592, 0.546, 0.435798 ], "color": "amber", "focus": true, "font": "editorial", "label": "BELOW PAGING THRESHOLD", "label_box": [ 0.227, 0.52141, 0.546, 0.191487 ], "label_size": 18 } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Location:** `huggingface-security-stack`

**Frame:** Focus on the separate `CRITICALITY` field. It remains below the threshold line required for paging.

**Action:** Severity is classified too low.

**Font:** `narration`

**Caption:**
> THE ALERT IS ASSIGNED TOO LITTLE URGENCY TO TRIGGER AN ON-CALL PAGE. DETECTION AND HUMAN NOTIFICATION ARE SEPARATE STEPS.

**Provenance:** `documented` — Hugging Face states the system failed to raise alert criticality correctly.

", "title": "Criticality stays below the paging threshold" } }
